recentItems.title: Can a Real Snake End La Voix’s Concentration Challenge? - BBC
recentItems.description:
Chris Hall and La Voix take on the ultimate test of focus.

Chris takes his turn in the hot seat, facing a series of challenges involving questionable dining experiences and far more makeup than he bargained for. Then La Voix attempts to stay locked in on RuPaul's Drag Race UK and EastEnders while Chris unleashes increasingly outrageous distractions—including a real snake.

Who keeps watching the longest and who cracks under pressure?

00:58 Round 1 - Restaurant from hell
04:40 Round 2 - Snake ambush 
08:05 Round 3 - The ‘makeover’
11:39 Round 4 - ASMR Office

Just Keep Watching is the celebrity challenge where concentration is everything and distractions are limitless. One player watches TV while the other tries their best to make them look away. The longest watcher wins.
